headline: Stlican Shelf Tilts Warden as Weathered Expanse Stays Fluid
war_summary: Since the last filing, Stlican Shelf has tilted toward the Wardens, six Warden strongpoints to three Colonial, after fresh base events in the latest two-hour window. Weathered Expanse remains the most active ground, with five base events in two hours and twenty-six in the day; its line now lies four Colonials, four Wardens, and one no-man's-land. Dead Lands, previously a casualty-heavy sector with no base event, now logs a Warden capture at Callahan's Gate. Linn Mercy still reads ten Colonial strongpoints to one Warden, though Lathair continues to draw the fighting. Stonecradle has quieted in the newest window but stays at five Colonial strongpoints to four Warden, while Mooring County remains twelve Warden strongpoints with no fresh change since the last edition. Callahan's Passage and Nevish Line remain casualty-heavy, with no recorded strategic-base change in the past day. No victor has been declared.
